subject: QBR + Roadmap demo — tight exec windows & proposed split format
messages:
From: Elaine Smyth <elaine.smyth@brightleafhealth.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightleafhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 15:42:00 +0100
Subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo - availability and constraints

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for partnering with us on the upcoming renewal QBR. A couple of constraints on our side that will drive the session format: our execs (CEO + Head of Product) are under an internal embargo midday on Nov 28 (12:00–14:00 CET) and are only available either the morning of Nov 28 (08:30–10:00 CET) or the afternoon of Nov 29 (15:30–17:00 CET). Procurement also wants a short legal/terms segment during the session (15 min).

Given those constraints, would Redwood be able to run a split-format session: a short pre-recorded demo (~20 min) that we can circulate ahead of time, then a 45–50 minute live deep-dive for execs + a 15-minute procurement/contract follow-up? Ideally we keep the live block under 60 minutes to respect exec calendars.

I've attached an attendee matrix to show who must be present. Can you propose two concrete schedule options (one that fits Nov 28 morning, one for Nov 29 afternoon) and confirm presenters for each segment? Also flag any technical prerequisites (dedicated env, model variant, or demo recording guidance).

Attachment: attendee_matrix.csv

Best,
Elaine Smyth
Head of Product Operations
BrightLeaf Health

> Samir

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear constraints and the attendee matrix. We can absolutely run the split format and keep the live portion to a single 45–50 min deep-dive followed by a 15-min procurement block. To make this concrete, two candidate options that respect your embargo windows:

Option A (fits Nov 28 morning exec window):
- Pre-recorded demo distributed by end of day Nov 27 (20 min)
- Live deep-dive + Q&A: Nov 28, 09:00–09:50 CET (Redwood presenters: Marissa will host the pre-recorded handoff, I will cover product roadmap + use cases)
- Procurement/terms: Nov 28, 09:50–10:05 CET (David to join for infra/SLAs + commercial)

Option B (Nov 29 afternoon exec window):
- Pre-recorded demo distributed by end of day Nov 28 (20 min)
- Live deep-dive + Q&A: Nov 29, 15:30–16:20 CET (same presenter plan)
- Procurement/terms: Nov 29, 16:20–16:35 CET

Operational notes / ask from our side:
- We recommend pre-recording the demo to a short 12–18 min clip (focused product walkthrough + one ops slide) to save live time. Marissa can run this.
- We need a dedicated demo environment and confirmation on any model-variant you want pinned for the QBR load (to avoid runtime falls-back during live).
- Legal asks 48 hours to review any contract redlines — please loop procurement if you expect doc exchange before the session.

I've attached a short run of show draft (run_of_show_v3.pdf). Can you confirm which option you prefer and also confirm the attendee list is accurate? Once we have a slot, I'll send an updated calendar invite and a /share link for the pre-record.

Attachments: run_of_show_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen

Looping in a few operational details so we can lock the runbook quickly.

Stephanie / David — proposed ops split: I will produce the short pre-recorded demo (12–15 min highlight + 2 demo scenarios). Stephanie will lead the live roadmap narrative; David will cover SLAs, latency/cost tradeoffs and the post-demo technical Q&A.

Key ops items:
- I need a stable demo environment by EOD Nov 27. Please confirm the model variant we want pinned (suggestion: redwood-v2-8q for parity testing).
- I'll record to a MP4 and provide a 20-min trimmed version. Attaching a brief with recording requirements and suggested camera/slide notes (demo-recording-brief.mp4).
- Procurement: legal needs final commercial terms 48 hours prior to the live slot. If they want to exchange redlines, we should use DocuSign and route to legal@brightleafhealth.com.

I'll also prepare a small facilitator script to stitch the pre-record into the live session. If you confirm Option B (Nov 29 afternoon) I can schedule a 30-min dry run on Nov 28 to ensure env readiness.
